name: Sean Rushby
headline: Head of Project Management & Delivery
about:
As the Head of Delivery for Australia, I am proud to work with some of the best project managers in the digital customer experience and product design space. Together, we have helped teams and organisations deliver numerous industry-leading products that create better experiences and outcomes for people. We have also won several lovely awards for our work.

I focus my time on supporting our project managers to continuously improve their agile capabilities. I establish and refine our delivery frameworks to ensure they are pragmatic, user-centric, and agile, taking the best practices from a wide range of methodologies. This enables us to consistently deliver high-quality results.

I work closely with business development managers on presales opportunities, account managers on new strategic initiatives, finance to track monthly revenue forecasts, and recruitment to continuously grow our team's capabilities.

With over 16 years of experience in project managment, I understand the challenges faced in delivery. The importance of synthesising complex problems into simple solutions and taking an entrepreneurial mindset.

Proposed and delivered a $4,500,000 IT modernisation project to Qantas Businesses across ASIA, US and Europe. Involving requirements gathering and feasibility studies of all business functions. Worked closely with senior clients to tailor delivery strategies which prevented impact to operational activities. Delivered project achieved 39% increase in labor utilisation and 47% decrease in support demand. 

Formulated the IT relocation strategy for 3000+ staff to new Qantas campus incorporating process design, business planning, audit & asset management and introduction of new technologies such as 'follow me' print (Cornerstone of ‘Qantas 2012 Corporate Strategy’).

experiences.position: Head of Global Hardware Refresh for Transformation Programs
experiences.description:
•	Successfully delivered an inherited delayed program to deploy hardware to 22,000+ users in 260+ offices worldwide (including embargoed countries of Cuba, Iran, Syria and Sudan). 
•	Re-designed the global planning and deployment strategy for both internal and external field engineers globally, while ensuring a robust change management and communication strategy was implemented in parallel.
•	Proposed and conducted a business feasibility study for Thin-Client deployment.

•	Managed planning, resource forecasting and financial budgets for multiple external IT transformation programs across a diverse range of industries.
•	Accountable for proactive risk and issue management.
•	Successfully deployed first dedicated corporate project management tool (Clarity) as part of a full project cycle.

•	Provided support to premium customers on Microsoft Exchange products as part of the Global Support Centre Team.
•	Proven problem-solving mentality from a business and technology perspective.
•	Leveraged internal and external resources to provide successful outcomes and exceed customer expectations.
•	Trained frontline Microsoft support desks engineers in India and Portugal.

Awarded for customer satisfaction by Alistair Baker (Managing Director of Microsoft) for effective resolution of customer time critical issues
